lines.en: label firsttimecafe:
scene cafe_day
I decide to stop by the cafe after refusing breakfast from Ami a good four or five times.
lines.zh: 在拒绝了 Ami 足足四五次早餐之后，我决定顺路去趟咖啡馆。

lines.en: It's nothing against her cooking. In fact, it kind of feels like Ami's carefully tailored her abilities to the best of my liking.
lines.zh: 不是她的手艺有什么问题。事实上，感觉 Ami 已经把她的厨艺照我的口味精心调整到了最好。

lines.en: I just feel compelled to get out and actually do things every once in a while.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得，偶尔也该出门，真的做点什么。

lines.en: Or at least trick myself into thinking that I'm doing things when, in all actuality, I'm just roaming around in hopes of more easily bridging the first half of the day to the second.
lines.zh: 或者至少骗骗自己，让自己以为在做事——实际上我只是四处闲逛，好让一天的前半段更容易接到后半段。

lines.en: Regardless, I am at the cafe now. And so I must do what is customary for any cafe-goer-
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我现在就在咖啡馆里了。所以我得做每个来咖啡馆的人都会做的事——

lines.en: Hit on the barista.
lines.zh: 撩咖啡师。

lines.en: : Next customer!
lines.zh: : 下一位顾客！

lines.en: scene cafe1
: What can I get y-
lines.zh: : 您需要点——

lines.en: scene cafe2
: Wait, Sensei? I almost didn’t recognize you on account of the normal clothes and slightly threatening aura.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei？你穿着便服，还带着点威胁感的气场，我差点没认出你来。

lines.en: : Threatening aura?
lines.zh: : 威胁感？

lines.en: : Slightly threatening. Like a bear, but if the bear was asleep or missing both of its hind legs.
lines.zh: : 只是稍微有点威胁感。像头熊——不过是睡着了、或者少了两条后腿的熊。

lines.en: : Good. That's pretty close to what I was going for so I'm glad the change of clothes helped.
lines.zh: : 很好。这跟我想要的效果差不多了，看来换身衣服起作用了，我很满意。

lines.en: scene cafe1
: Weird seeing you drop by, though. Didn't take you for much of a coffee drinker.
lines.zh: : 不过看你来这儿还挺稀奇的。我没想到你是那种爱喝咖啡的人。

lines.en: : So, what can I get you?
lines.zh: : 那么，您要点什么？

lines.en: : I'll take, uhh...
lines.zh: : 我要，呃……

lines.en: menu:
Black coffee
lines.zh: 黑咖啡

lines.en: : Just a large coffee please.
lines.zh: : 就来一大杯咖啡，谢谢。

lines.en: : Unless you're going to force me to use whatever the Italian word for large is.
lines.zh: : 除非你打算逼我用那个表示「大」的意大利语单词。

lines.en: : If that's the case, I'll just leave with nothing.
lines.zh: : 要是那样的话，我就空手走了。

lines.en: scene cafe3
: No one actually {i}forces{/i} anyone to use those sizes, dude. They're more of a quirky suggestion than a flat out rule.
lines.zh: : 其实没人真的会{i}逼{/i}谁用那些杯型啦，老兄。那与其说是硬性规定，不如说是个奇怪的小建议。

lines.en: : Forcing people to say {i}Venti{/i} and {i}Grande{/i} and stuff is more like a...fun little movie thingy.
lines.zh: : 逼人家说{i}Venti{/i}、{i}Grande{/i}之类的，更像是……电影里的搞笑小桥段。

lines.en: : But anyway, what do you take in your coffee? Milk? Sugar?
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，您的咖啡要加什么？牛奶？糖？

lines.en: : Just black, please.
lines.zh: : 什么都不加，谢谢。

lines.en: scene cafe2
: Woah, really? You're not just trying to upgrade your slightly threatening aura to full on threatening, are you? Cause I wasn't trying to wake the bear.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，真的吗？你该不会是想把「稍微有点威胁感」升级成「彻底有威胁」吧？我可没打算把熊叫醒。

lines.en: : Nope. That's just how I drink coffee.
lines.zh: : 不是。我就是这么喝咖啡的。

lines.en: : And you're not just trying to make things easy for me either?
lines.zh: : 那你也不是想让我省点事咯？

lines.en: scene cafe4
: Because I’ll have you know I’m pretty great when it comes to this barista stuff.
lines.zh: : 因为我要告诉你，在咖啡师这行我可是相当厉害的。

lines.en: : Humble brag, but I can kind of run circles around the rest of the staff here.
lines.zh: : 谦虚地自夸一下，这里的其他店员我都能甩出好几条街。

lines.en: : Impressive, but no. I really do just drink my coffee black.
lines.zh: : 厉害，不过不是。我是真的只喝黑咖啡。

lines.en: : If you say so. At least it’ll be easy to remember your order.
lines.zh: : 你说是就是吧。至少你的单子好记。

lines.en: : Who says I’m coming back? You still have a chance to blow this.
lines.zh: : 谁说我还会再来？你现在还有搞砸的机会。

lines.en: scene cafe2
: How could anyone mess up a black coffee? You just...pour it into a cup.
lines.zh: : 黑咖啡怎么会搞砸啊？不就是……倒进杯子里嘛。

lines.en: : Honestly, you would be surprised.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你会吃惊的。

lines.en: scene cafe4
: Guess I'll just have to take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 看来我只能信你一次了。

lines.en: : Total's 200 yen, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 一共 200 日元，Sensei。

lines.en: : Is that before or after my teacher discount?
lines.zh: : 这是用了我的教师折扣之前还是之后的价格？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. My b.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我的锅。

lines.en: : New total is 500 yen, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 新价格是 500 日元，Sensei。

lines.en: : Wait, why did the total go up?
lines.zh: : 等等，怎么反而变贵了？

lines.en: : Probs cause I used my employee discount on you. But hey, if you want to feel cool and use the teacher one instead, be my guest.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我在你身上用的是员工折扣。不过嘿，如果你想耍帅、改用教师折扣，随你便。

lines.en: : No, I think I'm fine with being an employee for the length of this transaction. Thanks, Rin.
lines.zh: : 不，我觉得在这笔交易期间当个员工挺好的。谢了，Rin。

lines.en: : I gotchoo, pal.
lines.zh: : 包在我身上，哥们。

lines.en: : Now go grab a seat and I'll bring your coffee right over.
lines.zh: : 现在去找个座儿吧，我一会儿就把咖啡给你端过去。

lines.en: jump chosedrink
(Copyrighted frozen beverage)
lines.zh: （受版权保护的冷冻饮品）

lines.en: : I’ll take one (copyrighted frozen beverage) please.
lines.zh: : 我要一杯（受版权保护的冷冻饮品），谢谢。

lines.en: scene cafe3
: Gotcha. One (copyrighted frozen beverage) coming right up!
lines.zh: : 收到。一杯（受版权保护的冷冻饮品）马上就好！

lines.en: scene cafe2
: I’m surprised, though. Ordering a feminine drink like that really makes your slightly threatening aura even {i}less{/i} threatening.
lines.zh: : 不过我还挺意外的。点这么一杯女性化的饮品，让你那点威胁感的气场变得{i}更不{/i}吓人了。

lines.en: : Now, it's like you're an unconscious bear without any legs at all.
lines.zh: : 现在你就像一头昏过去、连腿都没有的熊了。

lines.en: : Not only girls can enjoy (copyrighted frozen beverages), you know.
lines.zh: : 又不是只有女生才能享受（受版权保护的冷冻饮品），你知道的。

lines.en: : Sometimes, even a manly man like me likes to kick back and relax with a nice, cold (copyrighted frozen beverage).
lines.zh: : 有时候，连我这样的硬汉，也想放松一下，来一杯冰冰凉凉的（受版权保护的冷冻饮品）。

lines.en: scene cafe3
: Right, right. I guess you were just so masculine that I expected you to order a bowl of nails and beard oil.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我想你实在太有男人味了，我还以为你会点一碗钉子加胡须油呢。

lines.en: : I have no use for beard oil without a beard.
lines.zh: : 没有胡子，胡须油对我没用。

lines.en: : You still want the nails, then?
lines.zh: : 那钉子你还是要咯？

lines.en: : Extra nails, actually. Thank you for asking.
lines.zh: : 其实还要多加钉子。谢谢您问。

lines.en: : Damn, you're actually pretty good at this barista banter, Sensei. Most people would've said something really awkward or lame by now and here you are about to eat nails for me.
lines.zh: : 靠，Sensei，你这种跟咖啡师斗嘴的功力还真不错。大多数人这会儿早说出什么尴尬又无聊的话了，而你倒好，都准备为我吃钉子了。

lines.en: : I admire your dedication.
lines.zh: : 我佩服你的投入。

lines.en: : So, what do I owe you?
lines.zh: : 那么，我该付多少？

lines.en: : Total is 600 yen. You can just leave your money on the counter and go take a seat. I'll bring it over when it's ready.
lines.zh: : 一共 600 日元。你把钱放在柜台上，去坐会儿就行。做好了我会给你端过去。

lines.en: jump chosedrink
Tacos
lines.zh: 塔可

lines.en: : I’ll have the tacos, please.
lines.zh: : 我要塔可，谢谢。

lines.en: scene cafe6
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Tacos. The small, tortilla shell filled with meat and other various ingredients.
lines.zh: : 塔可啊。就是那种小小的玉米饼皮，里面塞着肉和其他各种配料的东西。

lines.en: : Have...Have you ever been to a cafe before? Or are you just guessing what's on the menu? Because all the stuff we have is listed right above-
lines.zh: : 你……你到底有没有来过咖啡馆啊？还是你在瞎猜菜单上有什么？因为我们所有的东西可都写在上面——

lines.en: : It's tacos or nothing, Rin.
lines.zh: : 要么给塔可，要么我什么都不要，Rin。

lines.en: : Sensei, we don't sell tacos here.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们这儿不卖塔可。

lines.en: : Then why was I even given this option? That doesn't make any sense.
lines.zh: : 那为什么还给我这个选项？完全说不通啊。

lines.en: : What option? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 什么选项？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Forget it. I'll just have a black coffee instead.
lines.zh: : 算了。我还是点黑咖啡吧。

lines.en: scene cafe2
: Woah, really? You're not just trying to upgrade your slightly threatening aura to full on threatening, are you? Cause I wasn't trying to wake the bear.
lines.zh: : 哇哦，真的吗？你该不会是想把「稍微有点威胁感」升级成「彻底有威胁」吧？我可没打算把熊叫醒。

lines.en: : Nope. That's just how I drink coffee.
lines.zh: : 不是。我就是这么喝咖啡的。

lines.en: : And you're not just trying to make things easy for me either?
lines.zh: : 那你也不是想让我省点事咯？

lines.en: : Wait, why did the total go up?
lines.zh: : 等等，怎么反而变贵了？

lines.en: : Probs cause I used my employee discount on you. But hey, if you want to feel cool and use the teacher one instead, be my guest.

lines.en: : I gotchoo, pal.
lines.zh: : 包在我身上，哥们。

lines.en: : Now go grab a seat and I'll bring your coffee right over.
lines.zh: : 现在去找个座儿吧，我一会儿就把咖啡给你端过去。

lines.en: jump chosedrink
label chosedrink:
scene black
I reach into my pocket for a few coins and place them directly into a tray on the counter before heading back over to find somewhere to sit.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里摸出几枚硬币，直接放进了柜台上的托盘里，然后转身去找个地方坐下。

lines.en: Or, at least that's what I {i}would{/i} be doing if I actually intended to hang around, which I most certainly do not.
lines.zh: 或者，至少如果我真打算在这儿待着，我{i}本会{/i}这么做——而我绝对没那个打算。

lines.en: Should I have informed Rin of this at the time of placing my order? Maybe. But she also should have asked.
lines.zh: 我下单的时候就该跟 Rin 说明这一点吗？也许吧。可她也该问一句的。

lines.en: So now there is not much to do apart from standing awkwardly in the middle of the cafe and waiting for her to return...
lines.zh: 所以现在除了尴尬地站在咖啡馆正中间等她回来，也没别的事可干了……

lines.en: scene cafe7
: Yo, why are you being such a sketchball? I told you to go find a seat.
lines.zh: : 喂，你干嘛鬼鬼祟祟的？我都说了让你去找个座。

lines.en: : I meant to order my drink to-go.
lines.zh: : 我本来是想外带的。

lines.en: : You know you...can still sit down if you order something to-go, right? Then just...get up once it's ready?
lines.zh: : 你知道……就算外带，你也可以先坐下吧？然后……等做好了再起来不就行了？

lines.en: : Or I could remain standing and make everyone here equally uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 或者我就这么站着，让在场的每个人都一样不自在。

lines.en: : I mean...I {i}guess?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}大概{/i}行吧？

lines.en: : So, do you have my drink?
lines.zh: : 那么，我的饮料好了吗？

lines.en: scene cafe8
: Yup! Got it right here.
lines.zh: : 好了！就在我手上。

lines.en: Rin hands me my order and smiles at me in what seems to be anticipation, constantly shifting her gaze from me to the drink I'm holding.
lines.zh: Rin 把我的单子递给我，带着似乎是期待的微笑看着我，目光不停在我和我手里的饮料之间来回游移。

lines.en: : Are you going to watch me drink it?...
lines.zh: : 你打算就这么看着我喝吗？……

lines.en: scene cafe9
: Ah- sorry! I was just curious about whether you’d like it or not.
lines.zh: : 啊——抱歉！我只是好奇你会不会喜欢。

lines.en: : I mean, I did order it. I wouldn't have bought something if I wasn't sure I'd like it.
lines.zh: : 我是说，那是我自己点的。要是不确定自己会喜欢，我也不会买。

lines.en: Wanting to appease Rin and quell how uncomfortable this is beginning to make me, I bring the beverage to my mouth and-
lines.zh: 为了安抚 Rin，也为了压下这越来越让我不自在的气氛，我把饮料凑到嘴边，然后——

lines.en: : So? Good?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？好喝吗？

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. But...
lines.zh: : 嗯……好喝。不过……

lines.en: : But what? Tell me.
lines.zh: : 不过什么？说啊。

lines.en: : Rin, this isn't even close to what I ordered.
lines.zh: : Rin，这跟我点的完全不是一回事。

lines.en: scene cafe10
: No. I suppose it is not.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我想确实不是。

lines.en: : Well, is there an explanation for that? Or...
lines.zh: : 那么，这有什么说法吗？还是……

lines.en: scene cafe11
: Oh, I guess. Though, it's less of an explanation and more of just me using you as a guinea pig.
lines.zh: : 哦，有吧。不过与其说是解释，不如说是我拿你当小白鼠使了。

lines.en: : You see, that's a custom recipe of mine. And I’ve been trying to get my manager to add it to the menu, but she’s been all like, “No way! You can't just change the menu, Rin!”
lines.zh: : 你看，那是我自创的配方。我一直在劝店长把它加进菜单，可她总是那副态度：「不行！Rin，你不能随便改菜单！」

lines.en: : So, I figured if I was able to actually get some more people on my side, I might be able to persuade her.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，要是能真的拉到更多人站我这边，说不定就能说服她了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : So, now that you've tried it and liked it, I'm going to need you to write on one of her comment cards that I'm the best barista ever and that she should listen to me more.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然你已经尝过、也喜欢了，我需要你在她的一张意见卡上写：我是史上最棒的咖啡师，她该多听听我的。

lines.en: : I'm not sure if I can, in good faith, call you the best barista ever when you didn't even bring me my actual order.
lines.zh: : 你连我真正点的东西都没给我端来，我不太确定自己能不能凭良心说你是史上最棒的咖啡师。

lines.en: scene cafe12
: I swear I was going to right after you tried this one!
lines.zh: : 我发誓，等你尝完这杯我马上去拿的！

lines.en: : Here, I'll even go get it right now. I just-
lines.zh: : 这样，我现在就去拿。我只是——

lines.en: : It's fine, Rin. I'll just keep whatever this is instead.
lines.zh: : 没事，Rin。这杯是什么我就喝什么吧。

lines.en: : It really {i}is{/i} good.
lines.zh: : 它真的{i}挺{/i}好喝的。

lines.en: scene cafe13
: You...You really think that? And you're not just lying to me because it's customary to flirt with your barista?
lines.zh: : 你……你真这么想？你不是在骗我吧——毕竟跟咖啡师调情是惯例？

lines.en: : I really think that. I'm going to need one of those comment card things if I'm going to recommend it to your manager, though.
lines.zh: : 我是真这么想。不过要是想向你店长推荐，我得要一张那种意见卡才行。

lines.en: scene cafe14
: Yeah! Totally! I'll go get one right now!
lines.zh: : 好！当然！我现在就去拿！

lines.en: : Just hang tight, okay?! I'll be right back!
lines.zh: : 在这儿等着别走，好吗？！我马上回来！

lines.en: scene black
Rin quickly dashes to the counter to grab me a card and I wind up having to sit down after all.
lines.zh: Rin 飞快地跑回柜台给我拿卡片，结果我还是不得不坐了下来。

lines.en: Unfortunately, a wave of customers all decide to show up at once and I'm unable to continue talking to her once I have my comment written.
lines.zh: 不巧的是，一大波顾客同时涌了进来，等我写完意见，已经没法和她继续聊下去了。

lines.en: Not knowing how long it will be until she's free again, I wait for a moment where she's distracted and place the card down on the counter before leaving.
lines.zh: 不知道她还要多久才能闲下来，我趁她忙得顾不上，把卡片放在柜台上就走了。

lines.en: And as I step out into the street with an indiscernible beverage in my hand, I come to realize something.
lines.zh: 当我拿着那杯说不清是什么的饮料走上街头时，我意识到了一件事。

lines.en: It's that I am now only slightly more than a lab rat.
lines.zh: 那就是——我现在只比一只实验用的小白鼠强一点点。

lines.en: And that the future of my beverage choice hangs in great jeopardy at the hands of a single teenager.
lines.zh: 而我未来喝什么，正被一个高中生捏在手里，岌岌可危。

lines.en: scene black
$ firsttimecafe = True
$ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdayafternoon
